scope: Sampler implementation comparison for frozen masked angular guides; finite-cap exhaustion rate changes, target and scores do not.
cost_contract: No new physical calls during fitting; each learned method inherits all5564 training-preparation and4096 training-source queries. Development source512 and warm-up404 are common. Count all capped search attempts, neural/geometry time and physical queries separately.
stop_rule: Training MSE, capped validity and correctness tests are not scientific success. Require repeated benefit over strong physical and same-cap controls, then independent molecular conditions and distribution checks before claiming ICLR readiness.
rationale: Tensor v1 exhausted228/256 and226/256 searches despite useful conditional proposals. Replace the inefficient uniform score envelope with an exact two-vMF envelope, retaining learned weights, cap and target.
envelope: Let gap=lambda_max(A)-lambda_second(A), v a top eigenvector. Base components have natural parameters eta +/- gap*v, weighted by inverse vMF normalizers. Reject by exp(u^T A u-logcosh(gap*v.u)-B), B=lambda_max(A)-logcosh(gap). Accepted density is proportional to exp(eta.u+u^T A u). Context-invariant constants and cap factor cancel in MH.
